selection: Manual exploratory selection from the unchanged automatic runtime catalogue; metadata names are hypotheses, not labels or validation.
hypothesis: This float controls ordinary lateral walking speed. Setting it from its observed 8.2 to 0 should suppress view displacement during the same movement input; restoring should recover displacement.
observation: Anode PNG screenshots at width 640, saved and evaluated automatically without per-frame model inspection. Verify the game remains the foreground window before input. No camera input.

measurement.primary: mean absolute pixel difference between before/after each pulse
measurement.secondary: fraction of pixels differing by more than 12 gray levels

limits: An exploratory reversible effect on rendered response to lateral input, not held-out automatic semantic inference, coordinate velocity measurement, persistence across loads, or proof of no downstream effects. Stable camera/scene and no collisions are needed; preserve failures and invalidate ambiguous outcomes.
safety: Only one numeric field, a fresh guarded write and the exact receipt's guarded restoration. No retries after uncertainty. Record file changes; do not silently roll back saves. Stop input on unexpected focus or state. Twelve short movement pulses total.
